changes_made.explanation: Removed non-NLG tasks (ATE is an NLU task) and models that were only used for downstream evaluation, not generation. Kept only NLG models and simplified dataset names. Added broader NLG task categorizations.
Normalized 'Fluency (perplexity)' to 'Fluency' as it's the same metric. Kept all metrics used for evaluating generated outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on controllable text generation for data augmentation in aspect term extraction (NLU task). While the main application is NLU (ATE), the core contribution is an NLG method for generating augmented sentences that preserve aspect labels. The paper evaluates generated outputs using BLEU, fluency (perplexity), F1, and recall metrics, but only uses downstream task performance (F1, recall) as indirect evaluation of generation quality. No human or LLM-based evaluation was conducted.
